description: Flat metadata schema for microbial genome sequencing records from soil samples collected across agricultural plots with different management practices.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual soil sample or derived sequencing record. Use a stable alphanumeric ID.

farm_id.descr: Identifier for the farm or agricultural site where the sample was collected.

plot_id.descr: Identifier for the field plot within the farm/site.

plot_replicate.descr: Replicate number or sample replicate label within the plot; use 1, 2, 3, etc. when applicable.

latitude.descr: Sampling location latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Sampling location longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

sampling_date.descr: Date when the soil sample was collected, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sampling_depth_cm.descr: Depth of soil collection in centimeters (cm), e.g., 0-10 cm can be recorded as representative midpoint or depth interval endpoint depending on study convention.

soil_horizon.descr: Soil horizon or layer designation, if recorded (e.g., A horizon, topsoil).

agricultural_practice.descr: Primary farming practice applied to the plot. Recommended controlled values include organic farming, conventional tillage, no-till farming, or other study-defined categories.

crop_type.descr: Type of crop grown in the plot at the time of sampling, e.g., maize, wheat, soybean, or mixed crop.

crop_variety.descr: Specific crop cultivar or variety, if known.

soil_ph.descr: Soil pH measured at sampling or from the same soil core; unitless.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as percent (% wet weight or gravimetric percent), specify method in study documentation.

soil_temperature_c.descr: Soil temperature in degrees Celsius (°C) at the time of sampling.

soil_texture.descr: Observed or measured soil texture class, e.g., sandy loam, clay loam, silt loam.

soil_organic_matter_percent.descr: Soil organic matter content as percent (%), if measured.

fertilizer_applied.descr: Whether fertilizer was applied to the plot prior to sampling (yes/no).

irrigated.descr: Whether the plot was irrigated prior to or during the growing season relevant to sampling (yes/no).

pesticide_applied.descr: Whether pesticides or herbicides were applied to the plot prior to sampling (yes/no).

previous_crop_type.descr: Crop type grown in the previous season, if available.

sample_type.descr: Material sampled; for this use case typically soil, but may include rhizosphere soil or bulk soil.

sample_mass_g.descr: Mass of the collected soil sample in grams (g).

sample_storage_temperature_c.descr: Temperature in degrees Celsius at which the sample was stored before DNA extraction, e.g., -80 for frozen storage.

time_to_extraction_hours.descr: Time elapsed from sampling to DNA extraction in hours.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction kit or protocol used to isolate DNA from the soil sample.

dna_yield_ng.descr: Total extracted DNA yield in nanograms (ng).

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform or instrument used, e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, Oxford Nanopore, PacBio.

sequencing_library_type.descr: Library preparation type, e.g., metagenomic shotgun, amplicon, long-read metagenome.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Sequencing run or lane identifier associated with the record.

read_length_bp.descr: Mean or nominal read length in base pairs (bp) for the sequencing data.

raw_read_count.descr: Number of raw sequencing reads generated for the sample.

assembled_contig_count.descr: Number of contigs assembled from the sequencing data, if applicable.

bin_count.descr: Number of genome bins or metagenome-assembled genomes recovered from the sample, if applicable.

taxonomy_assignment.descr: Taxonomic assignment of the recovered genome, contig set, or dominant microbial group, if determined.

functional_annotation_method.descr: Method or database used for functional annotation of genes or genomes, if applicable.

antibiotic_resistance_genes_detected.descr: Whether antibiotic resistance genes were detected in the sample or derived genomes (yes/no).

carbon_cycle_genes_detected.descr: Whether genes associated with carbon cycling were detected (yes/no).

nitrogen_cycle_genes_detected.descr: Whether genes associated with nitrogen cycling were detected (yes/no).

data_file_name.descr: Primary file name or accession for the sequence or assembly data associated with this record.

data_file_format.descr: File format of the associated sequence-derived data, e.g., FASTQ, BAM, FASTA, TSV.

bioinformatics_pipeline.descr: Name and version of the analysis pipeline used for assembly, binning, or annotation.

analysis_date.descr: Date when bioinformatic processing or analysis was performed, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).
